---
description: Implement the next planned task, test-first
---

Use the incremental-implementation and test-driven-development skills (`.github/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`).
Read `tasks/plan.md` and `tasks/todo.md`, then take the next unchecked task and only that one. Write a failing test first, make it pass, refactor, run the suite, and tick the task off. Stop there and report what changed. Never bypass the ClearDue human approval gate.
